assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original painted fantasy CRPG interface asset with the craft and material richness of late-1990s/2000s PC role-playing game inventory art. Detailed, beautifully hand-painted, dimensional, smooth controlled brushwork, convincingly worn natural materials, soft upper-left light and restrained deep shadows. Absolutely NO pixel art, NO visible pixel grid, NO low-poly facets, NO posterized color blocks, NO NES/Atari/8-bit treatment. Plum, antique brass, warm bone, muted forest green. No text, no border, no logo, no watermark. Asset: a square head-and-shoulders portrait of an original adult male lightfoot halfling ranger. Weathered expressive face, curly chestnut hair, warm hazel eyes, slightly pointed ears, a deep plum hood pushed back, supple worn leather straps and a subtle bronze clasp. He has quiet confidence and a hint of a smile. Intimate painterly portrait with subtle skin tones and a strong readable face, head about 62% of canvas height, shoulders cropped. Dark quiet plum backdrop, no scenery and no weapons covering the face. This is a fully painted character portrait, not a sculpt or photographic render.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A flat seamless material swatch for an elegant dark fantasy CRPG interface: very dark aubergine/plum bookbinding leather, restrained natural fine grain and subtle gentle wear, nearly uniform quiet color around #251c26. Flat diffuse illumination with almost no variation. Extremely low contrast so bone-colored small text can be placed on it. The material should feel physical, rich and hand-crafted, never plastic, never pixelated. No objects, no symbols, no borders, no corners, no text, no seams, no extreme scratches, no vignette or directional highlight. One square texture filling the entire canvas edge to edge.
